THE COURT IS YOURS

Just you.
And the basket.

No clock, no opponent. Find your spot and let it fly.

01 / MOVE
WASD or arrow keys move you around the court, in the direction you see on screen.
02 / AIM
Point the mouse toward the rim. Or hold Q / E to turn your aim. The dotted line shows your direction.
03 / SHOOT
Hold Space to build power, then release. More power sends the ball farther. You can also hold the shoot button.

The ball returns automatically. Press Esc to cancel a charge or pause. Stats last for this visit.
